name: PCR setup, thermocycle, and gel
description: Two-step PCR followed by gel electrophoresis. Synthetic Phase-1 fixture; does not reflect a real Benchling tenant.

steps.name: Mix PCR reagents
steps.description: Combine 12.5 µL master mix, 1 µL each primer, 9.5 µL water, 1 µL template per well.

steps.name: Load thermocycler
steps.description: Transfer the 96-well plate to the thermocycler.

steps.name: Cast agarose gel
steps.description: Pour 1.5% agarose gel with SYBR Safe.

steps.name: Load gel and run electrophoresis
steps.description: Load 10 µL per well alongside a ladder; run at 100 V for 35 minutes.

steps.name: Image the gel
steps.description: Image on the UV transilluminator and save the photo to the entry.
